20Mix%20it%20with%20ginger%20ale%20and%20lime%20for%20an%20effortless%20long%20drink.%20This%20one%20literally%20changed%20the%20way%20we%20think%20about%20bourbon%2C%20all%20because%20one%20man%20changed%20the%20way%20he%20thought%20about%20making%20it.%20Bill%20Samuels%2C%20Sr.%2C%20wanted%20a%20whisky%20he%20would%20enjoy%20drinking.%20Never%20bitter%20or%20sharp%2C%20Maker's%20Mark%20is%20made%20with%20soft%20red%20winter%20wheat%2C%20instead%20of%20rye%2C%20for%20a%20one-of-a-kind%2C%20full-flavored%20bourbon%20that's%20approachably%20smooth.%20To%20ensure%20consistency%2C%20we%20still%20rotate%20every%20barrel%20by%20hand%20and%20age%20our%20bourbon%20to%20taste%2C%20not%20time.%20Just%20like%20Bill%20would%20have%20wanted.%20Once%20it's%20ready%20it's%20bottled%20at%2090%20proof%2C%20hand-dipped%20in%20our%20signature%20red%20wax.%20Just%20think%20of%20it%20as%20our%20seal%20of%20approval.%20Since%20its%20establishment%2C%20Maker's%20Mark%20has%20continually%20impressed%20critics%2C%20winning%20double%20gold%20at%20the%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20in%202020%20and%202021.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F68e7eacbcf8a526c69d1a907%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F68e7eacbcf8a526c69d1a907%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F68e7eacbcf8a526c69d1a907%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F68e7eacbcf8a526c69d1a907%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F68e7eacbcf8a526c69d1a907%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%5D%7D%2C%22size%22%3A%7B%22measure%22%3A%22L%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A%221.75%22%7D%2C%22subtitle%22%3Anull%2C%22views%22%3A%5B%22alcohol%22%2C%22spirits%22%5D%2C%22basic_category%22%3A%5B%22bourbon%22%2C%22wh 2024%20SIP%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20and%20Consumers'%20Choice%20winner%2C%20a%20TAG%20Global%20Spirits%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20winner%2C%20and%20a%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20Double%20Gold%20winner.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efa55b430681218d811cc%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efa55b430681218d811cc%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efa55b430681218d811cc%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efa55b430681218d811cc%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efa55b430681218d811cc%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5720ae1747db6dca8a%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5720ae1747db6dca8a%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5720ae1747db6dca8a%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5720ae1747db6dca8a%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5720ae1747db6dca8a%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5520ae1747db6dca89%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5520ae1747db6dca89%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5520ae1747db6dca89%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb5520ae1747db6dca89%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnai 0and%20simply%20done%20right.%20Named%20after%20Evan%20Williams%2C%20who%20opened%20Kentucky%E2%80%99s%201st%20Distillery%20in%201783.%20Our%20Bottled-In-Bond%20Bourbon%20is%20100%20proof%20and%20follows%20the%20exacting%20standards%20of%20a%20Bottled-In-Bond%20product%3B%20aged%20for%20four%20years%2C%20distilled%20in%20one%20distilling%20season%20at%20one%20distillery%20and%20under%20U.S.%20government%20supervision.%20Evan%20Williams%20Bottled-In-Bond%20is%20bright%20gold%20in%20color.%20It%20has%20aromas%20of%20caramel%20with%20hints%20of%20vanilla%2C%20oak%20and%20barley%20with%20a%20taste%20of%20citrus%20on%20top%20of%20vanilla%20and%20black%20pepper%20notes.%20%20Evan%20Williams%20is%20the%20%232%20selling%20Kentucky%20Straight%20Bourbon%20brand%20in%20the%20world.%20A%202024%20SIP%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20and%20Consumers'%20Choice%20winner%2C%20a%20TAG%20Global%20Spirits%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20winner%2C%20and%20a%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20Double%20Gold%20winner.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb4a379c8705566cc501%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb4a379c8705566cc501%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb4a379c8705566cc501%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb4a379c8705566cc501%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb4a379c8705566cc501%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb4920ae1747db6dca88%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686efb4920ae1747db6dca88%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fp ame%22%3A%22Evan%20Williams%20Bottled-In-Bond%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22100%20proof%20and%20bonded.%20Evan%20Williams%20Bottled-in-Bond%20is%20the%20product%20of%20one%20season%2C%20one%20distiller%2C%20and%20one%20distillery.%20Our%20Kentucky%20Straight%20Bourbon%20is%20full%20of%20character%20and%20simply%20done%20right.%20Named%20after%20Evan%20Williams%2C%20who%20opened%20Kentucky%E2%80%99s%201st%20Distillery%20in%201783.%20Our%20Bottled-In-Bond%20Bourbon%20is%20100%20proof%20and%20follows%20the%20exacting%20standards%20of%20a%20Bottled-In-Bond%20product%3B%20aged%20for%20four%20years%2C%20distilled%20in%20one%20distilling%20season%20at%20one%20distillery%20and%20under%20U.S.%20government%20supervision.%20Evan%20Williams%20Bottled-In-Bond%20is%20bright%20gold%20in%20color.%20It%20has%20aromas%20of%20caramel%20with%20hints%20of%20vanilla%2C%20oak%20and%20barley%20with%20a%20taste%20of%20citrus%20on%20top%20of%20vanilla%20and%20black%20pepper%20notes.%20%20Evan%20Williams%20is%20the%20%232%20selling%20Kentucky%20Straight%20Bourbon%20brand%20in%20the%20world.%20A%202024%20SIP%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20and%20Consumers'%20Choice%20winner%2C%20a%20TAG%20Global%20Spirits%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20winner%2C%20and%20a%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20Double%20Gold%20winner.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef8c9566aa55b0bcb7717%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef8c9566aa55b0bcb7717%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef8c9566aa55b0bcb7717%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef8c9566aa55b0bcb7717%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef8c9566aa55b0bcb7717%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%7B%22origin rbon%20is%20full%20of%20character%20and%20simply%20done%20right.%20Named%20after%20Evan%20Williams%2C%20who%20opened%20Kentucky%E2%80%99s%201st%20Distillery%20in%201783%20along%20the%20banks%20of%20the%20Ohio%20River.%20Evan%20Williams%20is%20aged%20longer%20than%20required%20by%20law%20and%20bottled%20at%2086%20proof.%20The%20result%20is%20a%20Bourbon%20that%20is%20smooth%2C%20rich%20and%20easy%20to%20enjoy.%20Evan%20Williams%20is%20medium%20amber%20in%20color%20and%20has%20aromas%20of%20vanilla%20and%20mint%20with%20a%20taste%20of%20oak%2C%20brown%20sugar%2C%20and%20caramel.%20Evan%20Williams%20is%20the%20%232%20selling%20Kentucky%20Straight%20Bourbon%20brand%20in%20the%20world.%20A%202024%20SIP%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20and%20Consumers'%20Choice%20winner%2C%20a%20TAG%20Global%20Spirits%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20winner%2C%20and%20a%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20Double%20Gold%20winner.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef84664b16a2ab56489d6%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef84664b16a2ab56489d6%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef84664b16a2ab56489d6%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef84664b16a2ab56489d6%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef84664b16a2ab56489d6%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef832379c8771afe49929%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef832379c8771afe49929%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef832379c8771afe49929%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive
